issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Federal Jury Finds Feeding Our Future Mastermind and Co-Defendant Guilty in $250 Million Pandemic Fraud Scheme
notes: Retrieved via the in-browser fetch tool. Cited on the live index.html without this corpus previously having captured it; this record closes that provenance gap.
supports: A federal jury found Aimee Bock and Salim Said guilty on March 19, 2025 for their roles in a $250 million fraud scheme exploiting the Federal Child Nutrition Program, announced Acting U.S. Attorney Lisa D. Kirkpatrick.
Kirkpatrick is quoted stating the defendants falsely claimed to have served 91 million meals, for which they fraudulently received nearly $250 million in federal funds.
